bass.chain: HPF (28 Hz) -> Comp (glue 3:1) -> M/S mono-izer (<120 Hz) -> Saturation (tube)

synth.chain: EQ (carve) -> Comp (bus glue 2:1) -> Stereo widener -> Saturation (light, optional)

fx.chain: EQ (notch low-end) -> Delay/Reverb sends -> Limiter (-1.5 dBTP)

master.chain: Bus EQ (±1.5 dB max) -> Multiband glue comp (1.5:1) -> M/S mastering EQ -> True-peak limiter

parallel_compression.reasoning: Phonk's dense, heavily limited master requires high wet blend (50-65%) to achieve the genre's characteristic low-PLR punch and compressed energy; fast attack (1-3 ms) and short release (50-80 ms per PDF spec) glue the 808 kick to the rest of the drum bus.

kick.exclusive_claim: 40-65 Hz peak; 808 sub layer must not be boosted on any other track.

bass.exclusive_claim: 30-200 Hz; pitched 808 glide owns sub register; notch kick f0 on bass EQ.

chords.exclusive_claim: 250-500 Hz; sparse voicing; root raised above 250 Hz to clear 808 sub.

melody.exclusive_claim: 800 Hz-2 kHz; sparse dark lead; every other track yields here.

arp.exclusive_claim: 2-6 kHz cowbell/arp; -3 dB notch at melody presence peak.

pads.exclusive_claim: Side channel primarily; mid scooped -2 dB at 1-2 kHz.

fx.exclusive_claim: Above 6 kHz + broadband vinyl crackle; not simultaneous with stabs.

percussion.exclusive_claim: Cowbell occupies 600 Hz-3 kHz; hats above 4 kHz.

intro.exclusive_claim: First 8 bars only; vinyl crackle dominant before first kick entry.

streaming.notes: Phonk masters tend to push toward -14 LUFS ceiling with high limiting density; PLR 8-10 dB is the genre target — do not over-compress below PLR 7.

broadcast.notes: EBU R128 tolerance ±0.5 LU; vinyl crackle FX layer must not push true-peak above -3 dBTP.

sync_licensing.notes: Stems mandatory. Deliver separate vinyl crackle stem and dry stems. Music editor will re-balance; leave dynamic range in.

branches.kick_desc: Pure sine sub kick, minimal harmonics, instant attack, sub register

bass.avoid: B2+ (centroid drifts into kick critical band)

branches.kick_desc: Analog-modeled kick with moderate harmonic density, instant attack, bass register
Dark, slow-attack sub kick (808-style pitched glide), sub register — primary Phonk kick type

bass.avoid: any A0 R0 (Haas fusion collision with 808 onset)
